mapper.select: SELECT r.room_name roomName, r.room_no roomNo,r.room_limit roomLimit, case when rs.room_no IS NOT NULL then '예약불가' ELSE '예약가능' END status FROM room r left JOIN reservation rs ON r.room_no = rs.room_no and rs.reservation_date=#{reservationDate} and rs.reservation_option=#{reservationOption}
SELECT reservation_no reservationNo FROM reservation WHERE room_no=#{roomNo} AND reservation_date=#{reservationDate} AND reservation_option=#{reservationOption}
